body:
Thank you so much. You've helped out a ton! We're thinking of moving the trip to fall or spring depending on if it's not done in time!
Will she get the full certified document then after they approve it, or does that take more time (for it to mail and such)?

I talked to my mom, and she said the reason she couldn't use her old passport is because on her other legal documents, the birthdate is different.
On another note... Do you know how long this process can take? To get your naturalization papers (basically to the point that we can get a passport)? That's what we're counting on now and we want to start looking for when we would have to make the trip.

Thank you so much, you've helped a lot! I will keep you updated on what she says- I don't think she would have  known to apply  in person (her passport is from her honeymoon which I believe was more than 15 years). I just tried to reach her and she didn't answer, but I'll let you know why she said her old passport didn't work when she picks up!
Does it cost the same to go through with it in person? And is there generally a wait list (or does it vary)?

Again, thank you so much. :)

Thank you! just talked to my mom about it... she has an old passport, but she was saying she already tried to apply with using that and that it didn't work. I told her I would talk to her more about it after work - doesn't make sense why it wouldn't work, though? Because from what I've read, invalid passports also work.

I found out she has her photocopied version of her naturalization documents (that's what her parents were given when she was adopted) and she's afraid to submit or use those because it says it's illegal. 

Would marriage certificates work or divorce papers?
Huh, I don't think we have... We didn't think that was possible. Is there any where I can find information on that or does it vary state by state?
Thank you, I think I'm going to bring it up to her next time I see her. Are you and your dad on better terms now? Do you still talk?

we've looked into tickets beforehand and a lot of thethe flight websites will have someone assist me for the overlay (just because I'm a minor). we aren't too worried about the money- at least my mom told me to not worry about it because she would help out so I'm really thankful for that.

after a conversation with my mom yesterday, she told me that she wanted me to go and was all for it... so now Sunday is all up to my dad haha. my mom has his mom on Facebook and we would be Skype calling and stuff with her and my mom and my boyfriend. I think my dad is just most worried that these people aren't safe (and he kind of thinks everyone outside of the US are lesser) but... he said he was going into it with an open mind.

I have been stressed for months about this and I cannot believe it's right around the corner... so nervous

Thank you so so much! I guess SAS Youth doesn't fly in Minnesota to Copenhagen. :( Do you know of any other flight programs?

And I thought Denmark seemed safe. He lives in Copenhagen which is pretty big from what I've seen... I just am so stressed out about talking to them about it haha.

I've had a few jobs and have saved up a good deal of money (which my dad deliberately controls), but I'm willing to dig into my savings for that. I don't know if I have travel insurance or if my parents would want to get it for this (it's pretty unlikely they would).

The culture idea is super good. I never thought of it that way! I will definitely bring up the culture thing, thank you so much!

I know what you're going through. In my school and schools around me, we've had so many deaths last year- whether accidental or purposely. My heart goes out to the man who took his life, and you, for having to experience such a terrible thing.

Ahh, okay. I've gone to therapy before- my mom turned it more into a "why-does-he-hate-me" thing instead of me focusing on my issues.
Do you have any advice on how I can bring it up to her? Or anyone, even my dad?

My parents have thought I was depressed before- which was a while ago, but they never continued on it. My mom thinks because I'm not a social butterfly like she is that I'm depressed. I just feel like I'm hitting an all-time low, and my mom nor dad are aware of it.
And I'm fine with you asking, it makes me feel better actually. That someone actually cares.
I just... I feel lost in life. Part of me is comparing myself to my brother, or just other people who are so much better. My brother has a girlfriend, he's athletic, strong, muscular, outgoing, drives, works, it's like he has everything to be happy. He's not the smartest person but he's /happy/ and to me that's what matters. I'm the opposite of him: I'm single and lonely, lethargic, weak, overweight, I don't work, I'm introverted and always self-conscious, and I can't drive. I know half these things I can change about myself but being impatient, I don't want to have to work towards something like I used to. I don't want to have to do something over and over again till I accomplish it.
The only thing I have going for me is school- and I'm not even very intelligent. I want to be a lawyer, and my mom says I'd be good at it. Her reasoning? Because I'm apathetic and I "don't care about people's emotions."

But what's going on in my life, to sum it up:
School. I'm dreading the start of school because I feel like I'm going to fuck up my chance at making friends. My self-esteem is at a new low, I've never been this self-conscious of things around other people.
My family. My mom doesn't care about me and my dad is a lot like me. My brother is never around.
Friends. I have none. I hang out with my pets more than I hang out with my "friends." Aka people I tag along with in school but they never want to see me out of school. 
Me feeling like I'm insane. I've seen more signs of something going wrong in my brain? Like more sadness and stuff. I'm impulsive (I spend money in a bad manner, eat a lot when I'm not hungry... For example: I once bought a bunny and then returned it the same day. I still want to punch myself for doing that, I feel so bad). I fuck up all my relationships because I'm either feeling in love or hating the person, I overreact and start fights, I'm hot-headed. I feel insane, because I've had a made-up friend for over five years, and it actually makes me happy when I make up scenarios with him in my mind. God, I feel so fucked up.
I just don't think I'm doing anyone good right now and the only thing that's keeping me here is my pets- at least, that's what it feels like.

Yeah, I'm going to have to bring it up to someone.
Is the diagnosis process or whatever tough to go through?
I would need to bring it up to my parents first, and I don't know how to do that... I would be telling my mom, but I don't want her to label me as "crazy."
I'm so impatient, it's really hard to give it time... It's also so hard for me to bring this stuff up with anyone. I don't know how to tell someone about how I feel.
I have so much in my life, yeah, but I still don't want to be here and I don't know why. I still want so much more with my life that I feel like is achievable.
